name: Dual-Approval Threshold Boundary Edge Case
description: Boundary condition testing the exact threshold crossing for Human-In-The-Loop spend authority (Rule BR-RULE-001 & BR-RULE-004). Spend up to $100,000.00 requires only a single Procurement Director signature (1-hr TTL). When exposure crosses above $100,000.00 (e.g. $100,050.00), it strictly mandates Dual Executive Sign-off (Procurement Director + VP Supply Chain, 2x tokens, 30-min TTL).
